topics.title: Tricki's condition and Mrs Pumphrey's indulgence

concepts.learning_objective: Describe Tricki's unhealthy condition at the start of the story and identify its causes.
Explain how Mrs Pumphrey's over-indulgence of Tricki worsens his health.

topics.title: The narrator's advice and the decision to hospitalise Tricki

concepts.learning_objective: State the narrator's advice on diet and exercise and what he meant by it.
Explain why the narrator insisted on taking Tricki away to his surgery.
Explain how fasting, plain food and exercise cured Tricki without any medicine.
Describe how life with the pack of dogs changed Tricki's appetite and behaviour.

topics.title: Mrs Pumphrey's gifts and the narrator's temptation

concepts.learning_objective: Recall the gifts Mrs Pumphrey sent and appreciate the humour of who enjoyed them.
Evaluate the narrator's temptation to keep Tricki and his decision to return him.

topics.title: Tricki's return and the irony of the title

concepts.learning_objective: Describe Tricki's transformation and his reunion with Mrs Pumphrey.
Analyse why Mrs Pumphrey's phrase 'a triumph of surgery' is ironic.
Use the meanings of words from the chapter's glossary in context.
Evaluate the narrator's character and the story's message about indulgence.
